new_holdout.note: Newly collected retrospective holdout. No target starts, positions, stats, DNP roster entries or target minutes are model inputs. Context uses history strictly before Nov 6. These predictions were not issued before the games.

minutes.rule: Minimize mean relative historical validation MAE with all-D1 guard; current/fresh game results never select hyperparameters.

limits: Positive-minute conditional accuracy, not DNP probability.
Recruiting labels are intrinsically pre-college but were downloaded now, not historical HTTP snapshots.
Past game rosters are observed after those games; target-game and final-season rosters are not inputs.
Archive availability lacks publication timestamps and is excluded.
Existing holdouts are reused research benchmarks; Nov 6 was collected after model selection, but remains retrospective.
